inputs.text: Open your eyes and look past the official script they are feeding us. They want us to swallow this story about an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent springing into action after a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. Why are we suddenly being force-fed this theatrical hero narrative by the Department of Homeland Security? They released video footage showing a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin, but it is all part of their carefully orchestrated distraction to manage public perception at major transit hubs. When the apparatus itself stages these glowing spotlights on federal agents in crowded public zones, you know the real agenda is complete behavioral conditioning and narrative control.
